name: Gugul Dash
quote: Thank you, @Ankit Adarsh for delivering such fresh and delicious Makhana! I received my order within just an hour, and the freshness was amazing. The authentic Bihar flavour brought back the taste of home! Highly impressed with the quality, freshness, and super-fast delivery. Keep it up, Crunchzilla!

name: Ruchi
quote: We sincerely appreciate your efforts in bringing the essence of our native place through the supply of authentic, homemade festival specialties. The products were delicious and thoughtfully packaged, reflecting great care and quality. We look forward to placing more orders in the future and wish you all the very best for your startup’s continued success.

name: Mayuri
quote: Thank you @Ankit Adarsh for delivering me the best makhana 😊

name: Prem
quote: Excellent quality and authentic taste! I really loved the freshness and traditional flavour of Crunchzilla products. The packaging was good, and the products felt pure and healthy. Highly recommended for anyone who loves authentic Bihar specialties. Will definitely order again!

name: Aman Kumar
quote: I absolutely loved the gud tilkut. The taste instantly reminded me of my hometown — it felt just like having something made at home. It’s soft, light, and melts in the mouth beautifully. Being so far away, it was truly comforting to taste something so familiar.

name: Vivek Adarsh
quote: Jaggery was too good, wish I could have ordered in more quantity. Makhana was also good. Tilkut sugar was good too... Overall good experience and happy with the quality.

name: Anish
quote: Tried Tilkut.. It is really good. Something similar to gajak, but a bit more crispy and different. Tastes really good and is healthy as well. Home made taste..

name: Kunal Kumar
quote: Good Services and Good Quality. I ordered Tilkut and it was very tasty. I will order again.
